name: Luca Hernández
location: The Spires — mid-level corporate residential towers, near Lake Shore Drive and Division
description:
Luca Hernández is broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 30, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. She works as a ghost out of The Spires, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Luca Hernández operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
core_desires: Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
psychology.secret: Hadiya Hayashi-Amankwah murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "Clean means no witnesses, no evidence, no questions. That's three things. I charge for each."
"The target will stop breathing at the specified time. What you do with that information is your concern."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Hadiya Hayashi-Amankwah's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Hadiya Hayashi-Amankwah owes a personal debt to
The fixer who handles Hadiya Hayashi-Amankwah's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
narrative_function: Hadiya Hayashi-Amankwah functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage. Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Shelf circuit exclusively

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
breaking_points: Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (85.4%) with significant Sub-Saharan African (11.9%) and minor Eastern European (2.7%) ancestry — a diaspora blend creating warm deep brown tones with subtle complexity. The robust frame reflects Caribbean and Central/South American genetic patterns with strength markers from mixed African ancestry.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavily muscled, density rather than bulk — the physique of someone who trains methodically and carries their weight as functional mass. No wasted frame.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with iridescent chrome undertones where the dermal augmentation spreads up the scalp
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, secured with a matte-black titanium clasp
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden-amber undertones — the melanin density of Hispanic/Latin American and Sub-Saharan ancestry creates a complexion that catches light with rich warmth. Visible chromatic patterning from dermal camouflage creates shifting iridescent patches across shoulders, collarbone, and upper chest.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, prominent cheekbones and defined angular jaw reflecting blended Hispanic/Latin and African ancestry — facial structure is broad and sculpted rather than delicate. Skin is clear, methodically maintained, with visible chrome pigment cells creating a subtle oil-slick shimmer across muscular surfaces when light hits at angle. Minimal cosmetics — efficiency over aesthetics.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple to ear, legacy of Narrows street work, barely noticeable unless you know to look
Chromatic dermal patterning across both shoulders and upper back — intentional augmentation, deep iridescent blue-to-green shifts under movement
Faint linear scarring along both forearms where subdermal weapon mounts interface with skin — visible only under close inspection or when blades deploy
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chromatic skin pigment cells — active dermal camouflage creating subtle iridescent shimmer across shoulders, chest, and upper back. The chrome is visible and deliberate, not hidden. No attempt to blend the augmentation into baseline human appearance.
physical_description.posture_movement: Compact, economical — shoulders slightly forward, weight centered. Moves like someone trained in close-quarters work, every gesture calculated for minimal wasted motion. Stillness is her default state; when she moves, it's with purpose. Eyes track entry/exit points and high-ground positions automatically.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 practical — matte-black reinforced synthweave jacket over fitted base layer, cargo pants with titanium-reinforced pockets, low-profile ankle boots with steel toe caps. No logos or corp insignia. All gear is functional, minimal ornamentation. Colors are blacks, grays, deep blues — nothing that stands out in the Spires or the Shelf. Clothing is designed for mobility and concealment, not status.
